disposition_reason: Lettuce and bell pepper from three urban farm sites in Greater Accra analysed for Hg, Pb and Cd by AAS; one sample per site, with irreconcilable unit labels.

study.design: farm survey (mixed methods with farmer questionnaire)
study.origin: urban farms at Haatso, Dzorwulu and Weija irrigation scheme, Greater Accra, Ghana
study.method: Pb, Cd: dry ashing with HNO3 and AAS (PinAAcle 900T); Hg: HNO3/H2O2 digestion and cold-vapour AAS; samples oven-dried at 105 C

findings.unit_original: mixed: header mg/kg, row μg mg x10^4
findings.integrity_flag: Unit conflict: header says mg/kg, row label says μg/mg x10^4, text converts 0.0150 x 10^4 mg/kg to 150 mg/kg, and abstract gives Hg ≥0.309 μg/mg; no reading is consistent. Pb and Cd identical at all sites.
findings.notes: Single sample per site (stated limitation). Fresh ready-to-sell produce, oven-dried at 105 C before digestion.
